panels.burned_in_description: Calendar-date labels (month, year and in most boxes a day) printed in every one of the twelve beige marker boxes along the timeline.
panels.notes: Viewed the full image and magnified halves: infographic of text only, no photograph, face or anatomy. Every marker box prints a calendar date more specific than a year, so direct_identifiers is flagged; no date values are copied into any authored field. Patient age and sex printed in the text are not identifiers on their own.

burned_in: Beige date boxes print calendar dates;
